_text: [excited] Pop! A new flower shoots out of his *nose*. [dramatic, building] And it rots. Right there. On live *TV*. [excited] He sweats, so the glue melts, and his flowers slide off like wet *stickers*. [dramatic, booming] Underneath? A THOUSAND rotten ones. [amused] Derek loses. You can smell him from across the *mall*. [proud, warm] And your little bud finally *blooms*.
